Hoops Biomechanics Manifesto

Deterministic physics.
Engineered for the hardwood.

Modern basketball is saturated with subjective eye-test clichés and ungrounded scouting narratives. CourtSpec explores how calibrated video and transparent telemetry can support more repeatable coaching decisions.

Core Disciplines

Four Non-Negotiable Principles

( 01 ) OPTICAL FIDELITY

Calibrated Tracking

The concept uses court references and source frames to make every reading reviewable. Production capture rate, tolerance, and equipment requirements must be measured in the intended court environment.

Player Impact Reviewed Calibration Traced
Read principle detail
( 02 ) SHOT PROVENANCE

Repeatable Mechanics

Release angle, elbow elevation, and wrist-rotation estimates retain their frame, calibration state, and uncertainty so a coach can compare like-for-like practice reps.

Illustrative Spin Baseline Illustrative Release Timing
Read principle detail
( 03 ) NATIVE WEB ENGINE

Zero Bloat on Courtside

Built with native web standards: HTML5, modern CSS layers, and vanilla JavaScript. The smaller dependency surface improves auditability while normal application and deployment security controls still apply.

Zero Dependencies Responsive · 100dvh Dynamic
Read principle detail
( 04 ) SCOUTING INTEGRITY

Consent-Led Evidence

Traceable telemetry can support more consistent review, but it cannot remove human or model bias. Production use requires consent, representative validation, and accountable decision-makers.

Consent-Led Governance Data Rights Defined in Scope

Data & Accessibility

Evidence before compliance claims

This website is a static product demonstration and does not transmit or persist athlete telemetry. Any production implementation must define consent, retention, export, deletion, encryption, accessibility testing, and incident-response responsibilities before launch.

01 / PRIVACY

Collect only what the drill requires.

Document the lawful purpose, responsible operator, retention window, and deletion workflow for every athlete record.

Read privacy detail
02 / ACCESSIBILITY

Validate with people and assistive technology.

The interface targets WCAG 2.2 AA patterns, but conformance requires formal testing against the final deployed content.

Read accessibility detail
03 / SECURITY

Deployment controls complete the architecture.

Use HTTPS, restrictive security headers, least-privilege data access, monitored backups, and tested incident response.

Read security detail
04 / TERMS

Treat this experience as a product demonstration.

Illustrative metrics, pricing, availability, and workflows are not contractual commitments. A production agreement must define scope, service levels, data ownership, and support.

Read terms detail
